Masked fixed-width sample of the official NFL Game Book starting-lineup table.

Source: the official NFL Game Book of a 2026 regular-season game, captured on a GitHub runner on
2026-11-19 with `pdftotext -layout` (capture workflow `.github/workflows/availability-capture.yml`,
run 44604867560).

Every player name is replaced by a mask that keeps the character class of each character (a
capital stays a capital, a small letter stays a small letter, a digit stays a digit) but never the
character itself. The file therefore keeps the real geometry - the column offsets, the official
position labels and the official jersey numbers - without republishing the copyrighted document.
The real names are read by the capture script itself and are published only in the parsed
registers, where every row carries its official source link.

The rows below are the four side-by-side columns of the official game book:
away offense | away defense | home offense | home defense.
